desc: Introducing the Ambidextrous Safety Selector, machined from billet 7075-T6 aluminium and coated in a variety of anodizing to match other popular Reptilia accessories. The Reptilia Selector is designed to be operated comfortably by both left and right handed shooters. Utilizing the same hand movements without either hand having to break away from the grip will ensure the shooter’s accuracy and application. The safety selector will be offered in a slick 75 degree throw and compatible with all MILSPEC lowers.
